context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 P0 bugs in Technician App have been verified as FIXED: (1) Profile Menu now shows dropdown with user info and separate logout button instead of direct logout, (2) Technicians can create interventions via POST /api/interventions and devis via POST /api/devis, (3) Bottom navigation has proper padding (pb-12) to avoid Emergent badge overlap.
